title: Lavender Cat Litter

details.usageInstructions:
Clean the litter box and fill it with Purepet Cat Litter to a depth of 2-3 inches.
Place the litter box in a quiet, secure spot where your cat feels comfortable and is likely to return.
When the litter comes into contact with liquid or solid waste, it forms small clumps.
Remove these clumps using a scoop. If a scoop is not available, use a small recyclable bag to pick up and wrap the waste.
Do not discard the remaining litter. Simply top up the box with fresh Purepet Cat Litter to maintain the recommended depth.
